outcome: malnutrition (underweight, stunting, wasting, severe acute malnutrition)
cohort: The study included 440 children under the age of five years attending SCB Medical College Hospital, Cuttack.
finding: The prevalence of underweight, stunting, and wasting was 38%, 45%, and 28% respectively, with malnutrition significantly associated with maternal education, low socioeconomic status, and poor dietary diversity.
cross-section timing: At a single point in time, for children under the age of five years.
